mechanism: Use one familiar inert object at the opening to calibrate a miniature world immediately. Let the small actors, tools, motion, shadows and atmosphere then sustain a coherent routine while the calibrator remains passive. Later, introduce one different external intervention tool exactly once, let it change one local state, and hold the intervention, affected object and internal reaction together so the story shifts from scale observation to outside control.

invariants.rule: Calibrate scale early with one familiar inert standard object.
invariants.purpose: Makes scale an established fact rather than a delayed trick.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without calibration the later intervention is mistaken for a scale reveal.

invariants.rule: Prove the known miniature world through coordinated routine and local physics.
invariants.purpose: Gives the internal system temporary autonomy.
invariants.ablation_failure: A static model offers no relation to disrupt.

invariants.rule: Keep the opening calibrator passive after its proof.
invariants.ablation_failure: An active calibrator collapses the two external roles.

invariants.rule: Introduce one different external intervention tool exactly once in one continuous action.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated tools or cuts turn the event into ordinary handling.

invariants.rule: Show one changed local state and internal reaction with both scales visible.
invariants.ablation_failure: A hovering tool without consequence does not alter the relationship.
